latHint: Think a scraped knee - not cattle eating grass.
pivHint: Cattle GRAZE in the meadow - but if you GRAZE your knee, what happens?
winText: Just a scratch. GRAZE was the pivot - cattle grazing to a SCUFF on the knee.
lossText: SCUFF - a light scrape. GRAZE was the pivot: cattle grazing to a GRAZEd knee.
